title: Prove rank-three mask attribution through four stages
body:
Any dimension admits mask-only attribution when all overlaps occur at one stage. Through four stages, exact saturated projector identities reject every rank-three nonpartition in the enumerated class.

## Scope and source

Extends #7918. An absolutely irreducible three-dimensional literal control has even q targets and no HOSTs. Strict support and the tight odd-HOST setting remain open. The source extension is #7869 at `06c207a9feb3994a4b987dc3010657b6e85b7956`. Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; toolkit #7852 `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`. The included source manifest identifies every public dependency used.

## Reproduction

Extract `research/p104-q0-rank-three-mask-cover/replay.tar.gz` into an empty directory, check its checksum manifest, and run the extracted commands. `python3 -B verify.py` passes the two enumeration methods, pinned and independent symbolics, rank-nine irreducibility, and a mutation. The k=4 enumeration covers all 27,750 compatible multisets. Hosted execution is separate.

## Open next questions

Try five or more stages or additional shared-stage structure with the precise polynomial operator assumptions.

Clear1nsight prepared this result with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit DreamingOfClouds for the P104 toolkit and the predecessor authors identified in the archive. [Campaign board](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19789228).
